note: Flat faces of the Nezu jia (KIT.md § Flat faces). The vessel is ROUND and photo-21 was taken from ≈ 0.4–0.7 m: each face is the chord plane seen down the photograph's own line of sight (θ ≈ −4°, the drum face looked down on at ≈ 12°), so the flattened photo is close to an orthographic projection and the model is rendered down the same normal — both foreshorten the curved wall alike. Developed (unrolled) mm = r·asin(x / r) for a point x mm from the centre line. Landmarks are the décor borders on the nose axis, the drum / rim silhouettes and the crest of the slab and wall flanges at θ 60 (off-plane points: perspective at this distance is the main residual). Scale is INFERRED (rim Ø 176 mm).
